description: POST /v1/sessions/:id/retry-webhook with the cached sk_* key of the selected mode, else POST /v1/merchants/me/sessions/:id/retry-webhook with a fresh JWT. Queues one attempt of the session's latest webhook event to every enabled endpoint subscribed to its type; delivery is at-least-once, so the receiver may see a duplicate. Available at any time, including after the automatic retries ran out and while one is scheduled: the manual attempt neither consumes nor shifts the automatic retries and is not retried itself. Answers 202. Endpoints with a manual resend pending, or one of this event queued in the last 60 seconds, are skipped; refusals arrive as 404/409/429 with a code. Check the outcome with sessions_webhook_status; replay an older event with webhooks_resend_delivery. Webhook guide: https://api.harness.stablecoinx.com/guides/webhooks.md
name: sessions_retry_webhook
title: Resend the latest webhook event of a session
